user.title: Connect your Hive heating
user.description: Pair the SLR1c receiver and SLT3b thermostat with each other and with ZHA before setup. Copy each device's IEEE address from its Device info page in Home Assistant. Both addresses are required; no defaults are supplied.

error.invalid_settings: Check the addresses, name and boost values. Use different device addresses, 1–360 minutes and 5–32°C in half-degree steps.
error.receiver_not_found: Cannot find the receiver's clusters on endpoint 5. Check the IEEE address and that ZHA has finished loading.
